scripts.dev: npm run build:sdk && concurrently -k -n sdk,checkout,demo -c blue,magenta,green "npm:watch:sdk" "npm -w apps/checkout run dev" "npm -w apps/demo run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:sdk && npm -w apps/checkout run build && npm -w apps/demo run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/sdk && tsc -p apps/checkout && tsc -p apps/demo
